description: This Java class defines a data container for parameters related to the current period of a loan schedule in a loan management system. It includes financial amounts such as interest, principal, fees, and penalties, along with state flags and related methods to modify these values and retrieve aggregated data.

classes.name: ScheduleCurrentPeriodParams
classes.description: A parameter object encapsulating all the financial and state data needed to represent and manipulate a loan's current period in a schedule.

methods.name: getEarlyPaidAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount paid early during the period.

methods.name: plusEarlyPaidAmount
methods.description: Adds a specified amount to the early paid amount.

methods.name: minusEarlyPaidAmount
methods.description: Subtracts a specified amount from the early paid amount.

methods.name: getLastInstallment
methods.description: Returns the last installment's schedule period.

methods.name: setLastInstallment
methods.description: Sets the last installment's schedule period.

methods.name: isSkipCurrentLoop
methods.description: Checks if the current loop should be skipped.

methods.name: setSkipCurrentLoop
methods.description: Sets whether to skip the current loop.

methods.name: getInterestForThisPeriod
methods.description: Returns the interest amount for this period.

methods.name: setInterestForThisPeriod
methods.description: Sets the interest amount for this period.

methods.name: minusInterestForThisPeriod
methods.description: Subtracts a specified interest amount from the interest for this period.

methods.name: getPrincipalForThisPeriod
methods.description: Returns the principal amount for this period.

methods.name: setPrincipalForThisPeriod
methods.description: Sets the principal amount for this period.

methods.name: plusPrincipalForThisPeriod
methods.description: Adds a specified amount to the principal for this period.

methods.name: minusPrincipalForThisPeriod
methods.description: Subtracts a specified amount from the principal for this period.

methods.name: getReducedBalance
methods.description: Returns the reduced balance after adjustments.

methods.name: setReducedBalance
methods.description: Sets the reduced balance.

methods.name: getFeeChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Returns fee charges for the installment.

methods.name: setFeeChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Sets fee charges for the installment.

methods.name: minusFeeChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Subtracts a fee charge from the installment.

methods.name: getPenaltyChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Returns penalty charges for the installment.

methods.name: setPenaltyChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Sets penalty charges for the installment.

methods.name: minusPenaltyChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Subtracts penalty charges from the installment.

methods.name: fetchTotalAmountForPeriod
methods.description: Calculates and returns total amount (principal, interest, fees, penalties) for this period.

methods.name: isEmiAmountChanged
methods.description: Checks if the EMI amount has changed.

methods.name: setEmiAmountChanged
methods.description: Sets whether the EMI amount has changed.

methods.name: getInterestCalculationGraceOnRepaymentPeriodFraction
methods.description: Returns the interest calculation grace period fraction.
